name: NextExplorer
description: NextExplorer is a modern, self-hosted web-based file explorer with secure access control and a polished UI. Features include fast previews for images, videos, and PDFs, a built-in code/text editor with syntax highlighting, link-based file sharing (read-only or read-write), ripgrep-powered search across filenames and content, and multiple view modes (grid, list, column). Security is built in with local users and groups, optional OIDC/SSO integration, account lockout policies, and session management. Toggle "Show more settings" for advanced options including OIDC single sign-on, reverse proxy trust, and account lockout configuration.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Persistent storage for database, settings, and session data. Do not delete.

paths.name: Cache Path
paths.description: Thumbnail cache and search indexes. Safe to clear if troubleshooting.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Root directory to browse. Mounted paths appear as top-level volumes in the UI. Add more by clicking 'Add another Path'.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the NextExplorer web interface.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: External URL used for cookies, CORS, and callback URLs. Set this to your reverse proxy URL if using one (no trailing slash).

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Email for the admin account created on first launch. Only used during initial setup.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the admin account created on first launch. Only used during initial setup.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Random string (32+ chars) used to sign session cookies. Set a stable value to keep sessions valid across container restarts. Leave blank to auto-generate (sessions reset on restart).

variables.name: Container Port
variables.description: Internal container port. Should match the Web UI Port mapping.

variables.name: Enable OIDC
variables.description: Set to 'true' to enable OpenID Connect single sign-on. Requires OIDC provider configuration below.

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: Client ID from your OIDC identity provider (e.g. Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak).

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret from your OIDC identity provider.

variables.name: OIDC Issuer URL
variables.description: OIDC issuer/discovery URL from your identity provider (e.g. https://auth.example.com).

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Express trust proxy setting for running behind a reverse proxy. Usually auto-derived from PUBLIC_URL. Set to 'true', a number of hops, or a CIDR range if needed.

variables.name: Max Failed Logins
variables.description: Number of failed login attempts before the account is temporarily locked.

variables.name: Lockout Duration (minutes)
variables.description: Duration in minutes that an account stays locked after exceeding failed login attempts.
